mechanism_narrative: An upward revision in GDP growth (GDPC1) from vintage to revised value indicates stronger-than-expected economic activity, reducing recession risk and increasing equity valuation multiples, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >60% of instances where GDPC1 vintage_value < revised_value, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and triggering equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of INDPRO < 90.0 events, or INDPRO decline does not correlate with negative returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS at or below 0.2% signals extreme monetary easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in >55% of FEDFUNDS <= 0.2% events, or the signal fails to outperform baseline returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 8.5% indicates deep labor market distress, increasing consumer spending uncertainty and reducing corporate profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in >60% of UNRATE > 8.5% events, or the signal shows no statistical significance (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration, increasing recession risk and equity volatility, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of PAYEMS decline AND UNRATE rise events, or the interaction effect is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 510.0 indicates weakening residential demand, reducing construction sector activity and consumer confidence, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of HOUST < 510.0 events, or the signal has negative Rank IC over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL below 215.0 indicates low inflation, reducing real interest rate uncertainty and supporting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in >55% of CPIAUCSL < 215.0 events, or the signal does not outperform random chance (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In post-crisis liquidity conditions, FEDFUNDS at 0.15% combined with upward GDP revisions (GDPC1) signals policy effectiveness, reducing risk premia and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in >60% of FEDFUNDS <= 0.2% AND GDPC1 upward revision events, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
